Recommendation of TRAI on open sky
policy
*122. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any recommendations/
suggestions have been made by TRAI on
Open Sky Policy for DTH and VSAT
Services;
(b) if so, the details of the
recommendations/suggestions made by
TRAI;
(c) whether it is a fact that the
Department of Communications has
rejected TRAI's recommendations; and
Funds under National Child Labour
Project for Maharashtra
*121. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:  Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of
Maharashtra  have been submitting project-
proposals for Child Labour Education and
Rehabilitation, under the National Child
Labour Project;
(b) if so, the number of child labour to
be covered and the amount of Central aid
sought for the same during the years
2000-01, 2001-02 and 2002-03 and the
current year, and the aid granted against
each request;
(c) whether there were undue delays in
clearance of the proposals and giving
grants-in-aid; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?

38
(d) if so, the reasons for rejecting the
recommendations made by TRAI?
Accountability of civil servants to
Parliament
*123. SHRI R.K. ANAND:   Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
make a comprehensive law on civil
servants to make them accountable directly
to the Parliament;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when will this law be enacted?
Provision of phones by Public Sector
companies
*124. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the share of
Public Sector companies in providing
phones in the last three years has declined;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Public Sector companies have been asked
to provide 10 to 15 crore phone lines in
next three years; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by the Public
Sector companies in this regard?
Indian contribution to United Nations
*125. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the contribution paid annually by
India to United Nations durign the last three
years; and
(b) the criteria to fix this contribution?
Medical camps for beedi workers
*126. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that medical
camps have not been held for beedi workers
in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) the reasons for neglect of beedi
workers in East and West Godavari
districts;
(c) whether demands have been made
for medical camps from these areas to the
local officers;
(d) what steps would be taken to attend
to such demands; and
(e) the reasons for neglecting these areas
totally by Government?
New coal companies
*127. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: Will the Minister of COAL
be pleased to state:
(a) the norms in terms of production and
profits for establishment of new coal
companies and the names of companies
which do not satisfy the norms;
(b) whether Talcher Division of
Mahanadi Coalfields Limited can be
constituted into a separate company on the
basis of its production, profits and
potential; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Help to Afghanistan
*128. SHRI LALIT SURI:  Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to help Afghanistan in the task of building
their Parliament complex and the repairing

39
and renovation of other buildings which
were  damaged during the internal armed
conflict in that country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the financial and other assistance proposed
to be extended and the time-frame fixed
for the purpose?
Administrative reforms
*129. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Prime
Minister has initiated a major step on
administrative reforms and suggested a
National Entrance Examination for the All-
India and the Central Services;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to implement these reforms?
Increase in cases of death of Indians
abroad
*130. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN:  Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether there

Recommendations made by National
Advisory Council
693. SHRI YASHWANT SINHA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the subject considered by the
National Advisory Council headed by Smt.
Sonia Gandhi so far;
(b) the recommendations made by the
National Advisory Council; and
(c) the action taken by Government on
these recommendations?
Dissolution of KVIC
694. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have dissolved the Khadi and Village
Industries Commission on 14th October,
2004 and made some stopgap arrangements
before its restructuring;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the reasons for acting in haste in this
regard;
(c) whether it was not considered
appropriate to work out to revamp the
Commission to make it professionally
competent rather than dissolving it; and
(d) if not, the benefit expected to be
achieved for KVIC, promoted
manufacturing units and for consumers by
such a decision?
Allocation of funds for PMRY
695. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria followed for allocation
of funds under the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar
Yojana and the guidelines laid down for
the use of these funds;
(b) the amount of financial assistance
allocated and released under PMRY during
the last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether some States have requested
for allocation of more funds under PMRY;
and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard?

Schemes for ARIs
696. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have started
any schemes/projects for the development
of agro-based rural industries in the country
during the last six months;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise,
U.T.-wise;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the schemes/projects which are
likely to be started in the financial years
2004-05 (second half), 2005-06, 2006-07
for agro-based rural industries?
Road projects from Maharashtra
697. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a number of road projects from the State
of Maharashtra for the consideration of
Central Road Fund during the last two
years;
(b) the details of project finally
sanctioned; and
(c) the reasons for the pending projects?
KVIC in Uttaranchal
698. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of units proposed to be
set-up and number of people likely to be
provided employment during the current
Plan period by the Khadi and Village
Industries Commission;
(b) whether any target has also been
fixed to set-up units in the State of
Uttaranchal to provide employment in this
State; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
ARI in Maharashtra
699. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
boost up the grass-root agro-based
industries to generate additional income
and employment in rural areas, particularly
in Maharashtra; and
(b) if so, the steps taken so far by
Government in this regard?
Approval to revival plan of ECL
700. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the revival plan of Easter
Coalfields Limited (ECL) has been
approved by BIFR; and
(b) if so, the details of the same,
including relief and concessions from the
State Governments, Central Government,
total fund and non-fund financial
involvement etc.?
Initiatives taken to increase investment
in coal-mines sector
701. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some fresh
initiatives, like the single window project-
clearance mechanism etc., have been taken

155
to increase investment in the coal-mines
sector; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and their
present status?

facilitate the private participation in the
